definitions.explanation: the head of a faculty or school within a university

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{学部長|がくぶちょう}が{就任|しゅうにん}した。
examples.english: A new dean has taken office.

examples.japanese: {学部長|がくぶちょう}に{選|えら}ばれるのは{大変|たいへん}な{名誉|めいよ}だ。
examples.english: Being chosen as dean is a great honor.

examples.japanese: {学部長|がくぶちょう}は{来年度|らいねんど}のカリキュラム{改革|かいかく}について{教授会|きょうじゅかい}で{説明|せつめい}した。
examples.english: The dean explained the curriculum reform for next year at the faculty meeting.

notes:
The administrative head of a {学部|がくぶ} (faculty/school) within a Japanese university. Composed of {学部|がくぶ} (academic faculty) + {長|ちょう} (head, chief). The dean oversees academic affairs, faculty appointments, and curriculum within their division.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学部長|がくぶちょう}{選挙|せんきょ} — dean election
- {学部長|がくぶちょう}に{就任|しゅうにん}する — to take office as dean
- {学部長|がくぶちょう}{会議|かいぎ} — deans' council
- {学部長|がくぶちょう}{裁量|さいりょう} — dean's discretion

UNIVERSITY HIERARCHY:
- {学長|がくちょう} / {総長|そうちょう} — university president
- {副学長|ふくがくちょう} — vice president
- {学部長|がくぶちょう} — dean
- {学科長|がっかちょう} — department chair
- {教授|きょうじゅ} — professor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {研究科長|けんきゅうかちょう} — dean of a graduate school
- {学長|がくちょう} — university president (higher than dean)
